PODCAST: Understanding the CHL's impact after one season
By USCHO Staff - September 17, 2026

The old dividing line between Major Junior and NCAA hockey is disappearing.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:59
Instaread

Ed Trefzger, Jim Connelly and Robert Morris head coach Derek Schooley examine the CHL’s growing impact on college hockey—from a record-setting NHL Draft to a rapidly expanding recruiting pool of Major Junior players.

A record 19 current or committed NCAA players were selected in the first round of the NHL Draft, with 110 chosen overall. But the larger story is how the new CHL-to-NCAA pathway is changing recruiting, roster construction and player development throughout the sport.

The discussion then turns to four prominent coaching changes:

• Brett Larson takes over at Minnesota

• Nick Oliver succeeds Larson at St. Cloud State

• Rob Rassey follows Ted Donato at Harvard

• Eric Rud begins a new chapter at Alaska Anchorage

Which programs are best positioned for immediate success—and which new coach faces the most difficult transition?
